name: react-vite
title: React + Vite web app
description: React, Tailwind CSS v4, shadcn/ui, Lucide, Vitest. A static build served with serve.
conventions: One folder per feature under src/features. src/app.tsx composes the features and owns the routes.
shadcn/ui components live in src/components/ui. Add new ones with the same style as button.tsx.
Import from src with the @/ alias.
Tests use Vitest and Testing Library under tests/features/<feature>.
